reasoning_trace: Traced the three review-catch-only arms added at :1913 into Analysis.primaries() (:653-658): any arm with REVIEW in task_types gets [PASS, CATCH]. compare() (:731-733) restricts PASS to BUILD_TYPES; the arm has no cell on any build task, so n == 0, usable() (:577-579) is false, decide() sets nopair (:849-850) and returns the inconclusive clause (:873-877); decidable (:922) is always false.
finding: a0_bare_fable, a1_review_only and a1_no_dissent are components whose decision can never leave {investigate, keep, inconclusive}; remove/simplify are unreachable.
critique: The suite rules primaries_by_arm (ablation-2.0.yaml:113) know only build_only and all_types; the code maps 'contains review-catch' to all_types. No test drives a review-catch-only component to a decision.
remediation: Add review_only: [defect_catch_rate] to rules.primaries_by_arm; return it from primaries() when task_types contains review-catch and neither all nor a build type; render 'n/a (review-only)' at :1634, :1649, :1699; add a gen-fixtures scenario reaching remove and keep for a1_review_only and assert .decidable == true.

reasoning_trace: The hazard the refusal exists for is the open mount (toggles.oracle_open: true exposes review-catch answer paths). The refusal reads the declared eval_only flag; the oracle_open ⇒ eval_only coupling lives only in validate-suite.sh (:179), which pipeline-run.sh never invokes. A --suite-file with oracle_open: true and no eval_only runs the open mount with no refusal (dry run prints overlay=none(oracle_open)).
finding: The eval_only refusal gates the declaration, not the toggle that opens the oracle; a suite file that omits eval_only runs the open mount outside any batch context.
critique: Defense in depth: the runtime guard should key on the condition it protects against, or validate the coupling itself.
remediation: Set EVAL_ONLY=true when either .eval_only == true or .toggles.oracle_open == true (or die when oracle_open is true and eval_only is not), so the runtime enforces what validate-suite.sh declares.

remediation: Expose a plan function from lib/sandbox-mount.sh that both apply_arm_toggles and the dry run call.
